# -
염라강림 팬 게임.
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ko"><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>염라강림</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Noto+Serif+KR:wght@600;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--ink:#0b0708;--red:#b3201f;--gold:#d9b25f;--paper:#e9dcc0;--fire:#ff6a2b;--bg:#140a0b;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
*{box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
html,body{height:100%;margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--paper);font-family:'Noto Serif KR',serif;overflow:hidden;touch-action:manipulation;overscroll-behavior:none;-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none;-webkit-touch-callout:none}
body{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 110%,#7a1a10 0,#2a0c0c 40%,#0b0708 75%);}
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;background:repeating-linear-gradient(45deg,transparent 0 22px,rgba(217,178,95,.035) 22px 23px);pointer-events:none}
#app{height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;max-width:560px;margin:0 auto;padding:6px 8px}
.side{border:1px solid var(--gold);border-radius:6px;background:linear-gradient(#1c0d0d,#0e0707);padding:6px 10px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(179,32,31,.4) inset}
.nm{font-weight:900;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:1px}.nm small{display:block;font-size:10px;color:var(--gold);font-weight:600}
.hp{font-size:20px;letter-spacing:2px}.hp .off{filter:grayscale(1) brightness(.35)}
.meta{font-size:11px;color:#c9b88f;text-align:right}
.backs{display:flex;justify-content:center;height:46px;margin:4px 0}
.back{transition:rotate .3s,translate .3s;width:32px;height:46px;margin:0 -4px;border:1px solid var(--gold);border-radius:4px;background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--bc,var(--red)) 0 30%,#2a0808 31%);box-shadow:0 2px 6px #000;position:relative}
.back::after{content:var(--bk,'冥');position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--gold);font-size:14px}
#stage{flex:1;min-height:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;position:relative}
#field{height:150px;display:grid;place-items:center}
#log{width:100%;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;text-align:center;color:#e5d6b0;min-height:56px}
#log div:last-child{color:#fff;font-weight:900}#log div{opacity:.75}
.card{position:relative;width:96px;height:140px;flex:none;border:2px solid var(--gold);border-radius:8px;background:#000 center/cover;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 4px 10px #000;transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s;color:#fff}
.card::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(transparent 55%,rgba(0,0,0,.92))}
.card::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:3px;border:1px solid rgba(217,178,95,.5);border-radius:5px;pointer-events:none}
.card .a{position:absolute;top:4px;left:4px;width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--red);border:1.5px solid var(--gold);display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:900;font-size:13px;z-index:2}
.card .n{position:absolute;bottom:5px;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;font-weight:900;font-size:12px;z-index:2;text-shadow:0 1px 3px #000;padding:0 3px}
.card.sel{transform:translateY(-16px) scale(1.06);box-shadow:0 0 18px var(--fire)}
.card.big{width:120px;height:176px}.card.big .n{font-size:15px}
#hand{display:flex;gap:6px;overflow-x:auto;overflow-y:hidden;padding:22px 4px 12px;min-height:184px;scrollbar-width:none;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}#hand::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
#hand::before,#hand::after{content:"";margin:auto}
#info{min-height:62px;border:1px solid var(--gold);border-radius:6px;padding:6px 8px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.45;background:rgba(233,220,192,.08);display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}
#info p{margin:0;flex:1}#info b{color:var(--gold);font-size:14px}
button{font-family:inherit;font-weight:900;font-size:14px;background:linear-gradient(var(--red),#6d1010);color:var(--paper);border:1.5px solid var(--gold);border-radius:6px;padding:9px 12px;min-width:76px}
button:disabled{opacity:.35}button.alt{background:#2a1a12}
#bar{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin:4px 0}
.plays{font-size:11px;line-height:1.3;color:var(--gold);flex:1;min-width:0}
.ov{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(5,2,2,.88);display:none;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:14px;z-index:9;text-align:center;padding:20px}
.ov.on{display:flex}.ov h1{font-size:34px;margin:0;color:var(--gold);text-shadow:0 0 20px var(--red);letter-spacing:4px}
.ov p{margin:0;font-size:13px;line-height:1.7;max-width:320px}
.row{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center}
.coin{width:90px;height:90px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(#f3d98a,#a87d2a);border:3px solid #6b4a12;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:34px;color:#4a3008;font-weight:900;animation:spin .9s}
@keyframes spin{from{transform:rotateY(0)}to{transform:rotateY(1440deg)}}
.shake{animation:sh .4s}@keyframes sh{20%{transform:translateX(-8px)}40%{transform:translateX(8px)}60%{transform:translateX(-5px)}80%{transform:translateX(5px)}}
.pop{animation:pop .35s}@keyframes pop{from{transform:scale(.4) rotate(-8deg);opacity:0}to{transform:none;opacity:1}}
.side.flash{animation:fl .5s}@keyframes fl{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 #f00}50%{box-shadow:0 0 30px 6px #f33 inset}100%{box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(179,32,31,.4) inset}}
.side.heal{animation:hl .6s}@keyframes hl{50%{box-shadow:0 0 30px 6px #6f9 inset}}
.card .shine{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;mix-blend-mode:screen;background:linear-gradient(115deg,transparent 30%,rgba(255,255,255,.4) 45%,rgba(120,210,255,.3) 52%,transparent 62%);background-size:250% 100%;animation:shn 3.2s infinite}@keyframes shn{from{background-position:150% 0}to{background-position:-60% 0}}
.fl{position:fixed;font-weight:900;font-size:40px;pointer-events:none;z-index:20;animation:up 1.1s forwards;text-shadow:0 0 10px #000,0 2px 0 #000}@keyframes up{from{transform:translateY(0) scale(.6);opacity:1}30%{transform:translateY(-20px) scale(1.3)}to{transform:translateY(-80px);opacity:0}}
#bn{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;top:40%;text-align:center;font-size:34px;font-weight:900;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:8px;text-shadow:0 0 20px var(--red),0 0 6px #000;pointer-events:none;z-index:15;opacity:0}#bn.on{animation:bn 1.3s}@keyframes bn{0%{opacity:0;transform:scale(1.7)}18%{opacity:1;transform:none}80%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0;transform:scale(.95)}}
i.em{position:fixed;bottom:-10px;width:4px;height:4px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--fire);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--fire);animation:rise linear infinite;pointer-events:none;opacity:.7;z-index:0}@keyframes rise{to{transform:translateY(-110vh) translateX(30px);opacity:0}}
#info{min-height:78px}.side{position:relative;z-index:1}
#vg{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:14;opacity:0}#vg.on{animation:vg .6s}@keyframes vg{0%{opacity:1;box-shadow:inset 0 0 140px 30px rgba(255,30,10,.8)}100%{opacity:0;box-shadow:inset 0 0 140px 30px rgba(255,30,10,0)}}
.hp span:not(.off){display:inline-block;animation:fk 1s infinite alternate}.hp span:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.2s!important}.hp span:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.4s!important}.hp span:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.1s!important}@keyframes fk{from{transform:scale(1) rotate(-4deg)}to{transform:scale(1.18) rotate(4deg);filter:brightness(1.3)}}
.card.sel{animation:glow 1s infinite alternate}@keyframes glow{to{box-shadow:0 0 26px 4px var(--fire)}}
.card.dr{animation:dr .5s backwards}@keyframes dr{from{transform:translateY(-120px) rotate(-12deg) scale(.5);opacity:0}}
.card.lu{animation:lu 1.1s}@keyframes lu{0%{transform:scale(.4) rotate(-8deg);opacity:0}18%{transform:none;opacity:1}45%,65%{transform:translateY(-70px) scale(1.18);filter:brightness(1.5)}100%{transform:none}}
.card.ld{animation:ld 1.1s}@keyframes ld{0%{transform:scale(.4) rotate(8deg);opacity:0}18%{transform:none;opacity:1}45%,65%{transform:translateY(70px) scale(1.18);filter:brightness(1.5)}100%{transform:none}}
.sp{position:fixed;width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;z-index:19;animation:sp .7s forwards}@keyframes sp{to{transform:translate(var(--x),var(--y)) scale(.2);opacity:0}}
#bl{background:linear-gradient(#3a2a6a,#1a1038);border-color:#a98cff;font-size:12px;min-width:0}#bl:not(:disabled){animation:glow 1s infinite alternate;box-shadow:0 0 10px #8a6bff}
#dm{z-index:10;background:rgba(5,2,2,.6)}#lb{z-index:8;overflow:hidden;justify-content:flex-start;padding-top:7vh;gap:6px}#lb>*{position:relative;z-index:1}#lb>#lbd{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0}#lbd i{position:absolute;pointer-events:none}
#lb.th0{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 120%,#b03512,#2a0a0a 50%,#080304)}#lb.th1{background:linear-gradient(#0b1536,#2a1530 60%,#6a2a12)}#lb.th2{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#12033a,#06304f 50%,#55083f)}#lb.th3{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0,#5a4ab8,#160c40 55%,#050314)}
.lt{font-size:58px;font-weight:900;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:10px;text-shadow:0 0 24px var(--red),0 3px 0 #000;animation:ttl 2.5s infinite alternate}@keyframes ttl{to{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 30px #ff6a2b) drop-shadow(0 2px 0 #000);transform:scale(1.04)}}
.ls{letter-spacing:6px;font-size:13px;opacity:.85}#showc{display:flex;justify-content:center;height:200px;margin:12px 0}#showc .card{margin:0 -16px;rotate:var(--r);animation:fl2 2.6s ease-in-out infinite alternate,pop .45s backwards}@keyframes fl2{to{transform:translateY(-14px)}}
.lbtn{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;width:230px}.lbtn button{padding:13px;font-size:16px}
.ln{width:34px;height:46px;border-radius:40%;background:radial-gradient(#ffd27a,#d6361f);box-shadow:0 0 26px #ff7a2a;animation:sw 3s ease-in-out infinite alternate;transform-origin:50% -60px}.ln::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:50%;top:-60px;height:60px;width:2px;background:var(--gold)}@keyframes sw{from{transform:rotate(-7deg)}to{transform:rotate(7deg)}}
.st{width:3px;height:3px;background:#fff;border-radius:50%;animation:tw 2s infinite alternate}@keyframes tw{to{opacity:.1;transform:scale(2.2)}}
.pt{top:-10px;width:9px;height:12px;border-radius:70% 0 70% 0;background:#ffb7c9;animation:fall linear infinite}@keyframes fall{to{transform:translate(50px,105vh) rotate(600deg)}}
.gf{width:16px;height:22px;border-radius:50% 50% 50% 50%/60% 60% 40% 40%;background:radial-gradient(#cff,#3a8aff);box-shadow:0 0 18px #3a8aff;animation:fl3 4s ease-in-out infinite alternate}@keyframes fl3{to{transform:translate(30px,-40px);opacity:.6}}
.dg{width:100%;max-width:420px;max-height:100%;overflow:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;background:#150a0a;border:2px solid var(--gold);border-radius:10px;padding:14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;align-items:center}.dg h2{margin:0;color:var(--gold)}.dg .row{width:100%;justify-content:flex-start;gap:6px}.dg h4{margin:0;align-self:flex-start;font-size:12px;color:var(--gold)}
.thr{display:flex;gap:4px;overflow-x:auto;width:100%}.th{flex:none;width:34px;height:46px;border:1.5px solid #555;border-radius:4px;background:center/cover}.th.on{border-color:var(--fire)}.ch{padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid var(--gold);border-radius:14px;font-style:normal;font-size:12px}.ch.on{background:var(--red)}
.hp{font-size:15px;letter-spacing:0}.lk{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:3;display:grid;place-items:center;background:rgba(10,20,50,.62);font-size:34px}
button{box-shadow:0 3px 0 #3a0808,0 0 12px rgba(179,32,31,.45);transition:transform .1s}button:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(2px);box-shadow:0 1px 0 #3a0808}
.card::after{inset:3px;border:1px solid rgba(255,235,180,.55);border-radius:6px;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.6) inset}
.card .n{bottom:0;left:0;right:0;padding:6px 2px 4px;background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(10,0,0,.85) 40%,rgba(10,0,0,.96));letter-spacing:1px}
.card .a{top:5px;left:5px;width:26px;height:26px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%,#ff6a50,#8a0f10);box-shadow:0 0 0 1.5px #1a0000,0 0 8px #ff3a1a;font-size:14px}
.rr{position:absolute;top:7px;right:6px;z-index:2;font-size:9px;color:#ffd24a;text-shadow:0 0 4px #000;letter-spacing:-1px;writing-mode:vertical-rl}
.card.sel{rotate:0deg!important}#hand .card:active{filter:brightness(1.2)}
.hp{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;justify-content:flex-end;font-size:13px}.hb{display:flex;gap:2px}.hb i{width:15px;height:14px;border:1px solid #6a4a2a;background:#1a0a0a;transform:skewX(-12deg);border-radius:2px;transition:background .3s}.hb i.on{background:linear-gradient(#ffb04a,#e0381f 60%,#8a0f10);box-shadow:0 0 8px #ff5a2a;border-color:#ffd9a0;animation:hpg 1.4s infinite alternate}@keyframes hpg{to{filter:brightness(1.4)}}.hn{color:var(--gold);font-weight:900;min-width:30px;text-align:right}
.side.act{border-color:#ffe08a;box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(255,170,60,.6),0 0 12px rgba(179,32,31,.4) inset}
#stage::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:2px 0;border:1px solid rgba(217,178,95,.28);border-radius:14px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,rgba(179,32,31,.22),transparent 70%);pointer-events:none}@keyframes rot{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.lt{font-size:52px;background:linear-gradient(#fff4c0,#e0b860 50%,#8a5a1a);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;text-shadow:none;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 14px #b3201f) drop-shadow(0 2px 0 #000)}
#lb{padding-top:4vh;overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:hidden;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;justify-content:flex-start}#lbd{overflow:hidden}#showc{height:176px;margin:8px 0;flex:none}.lbtn{flex:none;margin-bottom:16px}.lbtn{gap:8px}.lbtn button{padding:11px}#dfr{justify-content:center;gap:6px}
.cg{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;width:100%}.cr{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;font-size:11px;line-height:1.4;text-align:left;border-bottom:1px solid #3a2a1a;padding-bottom:5px}.cr .th{width:44px;height:60px;flex:none}.cr p{margin:0}.pj{position:fixed;width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(#fff,#ff7a2b 45%,transparent 70%);box-shadow:0 0 20px #ff4a1a;z-index:18;pointer-events:none;transition:transform .3s cubic-bezier(.5,0,1,.7)}
.sl{position:fixed;width:120px;height:4px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#fff,transparent);z-index:18;pointer-events:none;box-shadow:0 0 12px #fff;animation:slash .3s forwards;rotate:-25deg}@keyframes slash{from{transform:scaleX(0);opacity:1}to{transform:scaleX(1.4);opacity:0}}
.side.low{animation:lowp .9s infinite alternate}.side.low.flash{animation:fl .5s}.side.low.heal{animation:hl .6s}@keyframes lowp{to{border-color:#ff3a2a;box-shadow:0 0 18px #ff2a1a inset}}
.ov h1{animation:pop .6s}#log div:last-child{animation:lg .3s}@keyframes lg{from{transform:translateY(8px);opacity:0}}
#info{background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(179,32,31,.28),rgba(233,220,192,.06));border-left:3px solid var(--red)}#use{min-width:84px;font-size:15px;animation:glow 1s infinite alternate}
.rl{font-size:11px;line-height:1.7;color:#d8c9a0;margin:0;text-align:left;border:1px solid #3a2a1a;border-radius:6px;padding:6px 8px;background:#0e0707}
.av{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--gold);background:center 25%/cover;box-shadow:0 0 10px #000,0 0 14px rgba(217,178,95,.55);flex:none;margin-right:8px;display:block}.side .nm{flex:1}
#vs{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:16;background:radial-gradient(#3a0a0a,#050202);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:space-around;flex-direction:column;pointer-events:none}#vs.on{display:flex;animation:vsf 1.7s forwards}@keyframes vsf{0%,82%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0}}
.vp{text-align:center;font-weight:900;font-size:22px;letter-spacing:2px}.vp i{display:block;width:130px;height:130px;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid var(--gold);background:center 25%/cover;margin:0 auto 8px;box-shadow:0 0 34px var(--red)}.vp.l{animation:inl .6s}.vp.r{animation:inr .6s}@keyframes inl{from{transform:translateX(-120vw)}}@keyframes inr{from{transform:translateX(120vw)}}.vx{font-size:60px;color:var(--gold);text-shadow:0 0 26px var(--fire);animation:pop .5s .5s backwards}
#mu{position:fixed;top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 6px);right:8px;z-index:17;min-width:0;padding:4px 8px;font-size:14px;opacity:.85}
.xb{width:200px;height:7px;border:1px solid var(--gold);border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;margin:0 auto}.xb i{display:block;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--red),#ffb04a)}
.card[data-r='0']{filter:saturate(.8)}.card[data-r='0'] .a{background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%,#9ab,#345)}.card[data-r='2'] .a{background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%,#ffb04a,#9a4a0a)}
.card[data-r='3']::after{border-color:#ffe08a;box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(255,210,74,.6) inset;animation:leg 1.6s infinite alternate}@keyframes leg{to{box-shadow:0 0 24px rgba(255,210,74,.95) inset}}.card[data-r='3'] .a{background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%,#fff2a0,#c98a0a);color:#3a1a00}
.cr u{color:var(--gold);text-decoration:none;font-weight:900;font-size:13px}

.fog{position:fixed;inset:-20%;pointer-events:none;z-index:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 15% 85%,rgba(179,32,31,.28),transparent 50%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 85% 75%,rgba(255,106,43,.14),transparent 55%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0,rgba(90,60,160,.12),transparent 50%);animation:fg 16s ease-in-out infinite alternate}@keyframes fg{to{transform:translate(4%,-3%) scale(1.08);opacity:.75}}
#app{position:relative;z-index:1}
.side{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(44,18,18,.92),rgba(14,6,6,.96));border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 2px 0 #000,0 0 14px rgba(179,32,31,.35) inset;transition:box-shadow .3s,border-color .3s}
.side::before,.side::after{content:'';position:absolute;width:10px;height:10px;border:2px solid var(--gold);opacity:.8;pointer-events:none}
.side::before{top:-1px;left:-1px;border-right:0;border-bottom:0;border-top-left-radius:8px}.side::after{bottom:-1px;right:-1px;border-left:0;border-top:0;border-bottom-right-radius:8px}
.av{animation:bob 3.4s ease-in-out infinite}@keyframes bob{50%{transform:translateY(-2px) scale(1.03)}}
.side.act .av{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(255,224,138,.35),0 0 18px #ffb04a;animation:bob 3.4s ease-in-out infinite,ringp 1.2s infinite alternate}@keyframes ringp{to{box-shadow:0 0 0 6px rgba(255,224,138,.1),0 0 26px #ff8a2b}}
.hb i{transition:background .3s}.hb i.on{box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(255,120,40,.6)}
.hb i.gn{animation:gn .7s}@keyframes gn{0%{transform:skewX(-12deg) scale(1.9);filter:brightness(2.5)}100%{transform:skewX(-12deg) scale(1)}}
.hb i.brk{background:#1a0a0a;animation:brk .7s}@keyframes brk{0%{transform:skewX(-12deg) scale(1.5);background:#fff}40%{background:#ff3a2a}100%{transform:skewX(-12deg);background:#1a0a0a}}
#field{position:relative}
@keyframes rot{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}#field .card{z-index:2}
.card.big.lu,.card.big.ld{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 14px rgba(255,140,50,.8))}
.card[data-r='3']::before{background:linear-gradient(transparent 50%,rgba(0,0,0,.92)),linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,210,74,.2),transparent 40%)}
@keyframes dr{from{transform:translate(90px,-120px) rotate(-18deg) scale(.5);opacity:0}}
button{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:8px;letter-spacing:1px}
#end{flex:none;min-width:84px}
#end.rdy:not(:disabled){animation:glow .8s infinite alternate;background:linear-gradient(#e8452f,#8a1410);box-shadow:0 3px 0 #3a0808,0 0 16px #ff6a2b}
.orb{display:inline-block;width:9px;height:9px;margin:0 1px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid #a98cff;background:#150c30;vertical-align:middle}.orb.on{background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%,#fff,#8a6bff);box-shadow:0 0 8px #8a6bff;animation:orb 1s infinite alternate}@keyframes orb{to{transform:scale(1.25)}}
#app #hand{transition:filter .4s}#app[data-t=e] #hand{filter:brightness(.65) saturate(.7)}#app[data-p='0'] #hand{filter:brightness(.8)}
#info{border-radius:8px;transition:border-color .3s,box-shadow .3s}#info[data-r='3']{border-color:#ffe08a;box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(255,210,74,.35)}#info[data-r='2']{border-color:#ffb04a}#info[data-r='0']{border-color:#789}#info p{animation:lg .25s}

@keyframes fwg{0%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-70%) scaleX(var(--s,1)) scale(.15) rotate(0)}30%{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,-70%) scaleX(var(--s,1)) scale(1.05) rotate(calc(var(--r,0deg)*.5))}100%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-70%) scaleX(var(--s,1)) scale(1.7) rotate(var(--r,0deg))}}
.fqi{position:fixed;width:var(--w,220px);height:48px;margin:-24px 0 0 -110px;pointer-events:none;z-index:60;opacity:0;rotate:var(--a,0rad);clip-path:polygon(0 50%,22% 14%,68% 0,100% 50%,68% 100%,22% 86%);background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,60,10,0),#ff5a0a 18%,#ffb02a 48%,#fff8cc 78%,#fff);filter:drop-shadow(0 0 14px #ff8a1a) drop-shadow(0 0 32px #ff5a0a);animation:fqi .42s cubic-bezier(.45,0,.85,.55) forwards}
@keyframes fqi{0%{opacity:0;translate:0 0;scale:.3 .6}15%{opacity:1;scale:1 1}100%{opacity:1;translate:var(--x) var(--y);scale:1.25 1.1}}
.card .shine{mix-blend-mode:normal!important;opacity:.35}.fog{will-change:auto}.hb i.on{animation:none!important}
body::after{content:'';position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:2;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,transparent 55%,rgba(0,0,0,.55)),repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(255,255,255,.018) 0 1px,transparent 1px 3px)}
button{transition:transform .1s,filter .2s,box-shadow .2s}@media(hover:hover){button:hover:not(:disabled){filter:brightness(1.18)}}
.card{box-shadow:0 6px 14px #000,0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}#field .card.big{filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.8))}
#info b{text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(217,178,95,.5)}#log div:last-child{text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(255,160,80,.5)}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){body::after{display:none}.fog,i.em{animation:none}}
</style></head><body>
<div id="app">
 <div class="side" id="es"><i class="av" id="eav"></i><div class="nm">저승 사자<small>AI · 명부의 심판자</small></div><div><div class="hp" id="eh"></div><div class="meta" id="em"></div></div></div>
 <div class="backs" id="eb"></div>
 <div id="stage"><div id="field"></div><div id="log"></div></div>
 <div class="side" id="ps"><i class="av" id="pav"></i><div class="nm">나<small>이승의 도전자</small></div><div><div class="hp" id="ph"></div><div class="meta" id="pm"></div></div></div>
 <div id="hand"></div>
 <div id="info"></div>
 <div id="bar"><span class="plays" id="pl"></span><button class="alt" id="hm" style="min-width:0">🏠</button><button id="bl"></button><button class="alt" id="end">턴 종료</button></div>
</div>
<div id="vs"></div><button id="mu" class="alt">🔇</button><div id="vg"></div><div id="bn"></div><div class="ov on th0" id="lb"><div id="lbd"></div><div class="lt">염라강림</div><div class="ls">閻羅降臨</div><div id="showc"></div><div class="lbtn"><button id="b1">⚔ 전투 시작</button><button class="alt" id="b2">🃏 카드 꾸미기</button><button class="alt" id="b3">🏮 로비 꾸미기</button><button class="alt" id="b4">📖 카드 도감</button><div class="row" id="dfr"></div></div></div><div class="ov" id="dm"></div><div class="ov" id="ov"><h1>閻 羅 降 臨</h1><p>견우와 직녀가 갈라선 밤,<br>이승과 저승의 경계에서 카드를 겨룬다.<br><br>체력 8 · 한 턴에 카드 2장 사용 (선공 첫 턴은 1장)<br>한 턴에 받는 피해는 최대 4 (저승의 결계)<br>카드를 쓸수록 혼이 쌓여 4가 되면 혼 폭발!<br><span style="color:#7fe">✦ 같은 턴에 연계하면 추가 효과!<br>직녀+견우 · 염라+노망 · 강림&지우+부리</span></p><button id="go">전투 시작</button></div>
<div class="ov" id="md"><h1 id="mt" style="font-size:20px"></h1><div class="row" id="mc"></div></div>
<script>
const IMG=['data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,','data:image/jpeg;base64,'];
const C=[
{id:'jik',n:'직녀',a:2,t:'상대 패에서 공격력이 가장 높은 카드를 덱의 다른 카드와 교체한다.'},
{id:'gyeon',n:'견우',a:2,t:'상대에게 1 피해. 상대 패의 전투력 0 카드 1장을 가져온다. 내 패에 직녀가 있으면 상대 패에서 카드 1장을 더 가져온다.'},
{id:'ilsik',n:'일식',a:1,t:'동전을 던져 앞면이면 카드 2장을 가져오고, 뒷면이면 상대에게 1회 피해.'},
{id:'jeje',n:'제천대성',a:3,t:'동전을 던져 뒷면이면 내 패 1장을 버리고 상대에게 2 피해. 앞면이면 카드 1장 뽑기.'},
{id:'buri',n:'부리',a:1,t:'상대에게 1 피해.'},
{id:'cleo',n:'클레오파트라',a:1,t:'덱 위 2장을 보고 1장을 가져온다.'},
{id:'yeom',n:'염라',a:2,t:'상대에게 1 피해, 체력 1 회복을 2회 반복. 패에 이지우·강림·노망·강림&지우가 있으면 피해는 1회로 줄어든다. 패에 일식이 있으면 괴이 상태가 되어 카드 1장을 가져온다.'},
{id:'gang',n:'강림&지우',a:3,t:'상대에게 2 피해. 물보라를 일으켜 상대 패 1장을 가져온다(염라 우선). 염라를 가져오면 1 추가 피해 + 내게 2 피해 무효 보호막. 권능을 해방시켜 체력 3 회복, 다음 턴 내 공격은 불괴·보호막을 무시한다.'},
{id:'si',n:'김시언',a:0,t:'체력 2 회복. 카드 2장 뽑기. 커다란 뱀을 소환해 상대를 삼켜 체력 1을 깎고, 상대 패에서 카드 1장을 가져온다.'},
{id:'no',n:'노망',a:1,t:'카드 1장을 가져온다. 내 패에 염라가 있으면 1장 더 가져온다.'},
{id:'ja',n:'서자빈',a:0,t:'카드 2장을 뽑는다. 내 체력이 2 이하이면 체력 2 회복.'},
{id:'oh',n:'백오수',a:1,t:'체력 2 회복. 적 패의 카드 1장을 잠그어 그 적의 다음 턴에 쓰지 못하게 한다.'},
{id:'da',n:'다해',a:1,t:'상대에게 1 피해, 카드 1장 뽑기.'},
{id:'so',n:'금소원',a:0,t:'카드 1장을 뽑고, 50% 확률로 1장 더 뽑는다.'},
{id:'mi',n:'적미람',a:1,t:'상대에게 1 피해. 40% 확률로 1 추가 피해, 이어 20% 확률로 1 더. 10% 확률로 체력 1 회복.'},
{id:'rang',n:'적오랑',a:2,t:'상대에게 1 피해. 내 패에 적미람이 있으면 형제 상태가 되어 연속 2회 추가 피해 + 체력 1 회복.'},
{id:'dan',n:'단오',a:2,t:'상대에게 2 피해. 적 카드 2장을 확인한다.'},
{id:'dong',n:'동방삭',a:3,t:'상대에게 3 피해. 금소원 카드를 얻는다. 사용 시 패에 금소원이 있었다면 상대에게 1회 추가 피해.'},
{id:'kka',n:'까톨이',a:1,t:'상대에게 1 피해, 체력 2 회복, 카드 1장 뽑기.'},
{id:'hm',n:'흑묘묘',a:0,t:'체력 3 회복. 30% 확률로 1 추가 회복.'},
{id:'tbo',n:'털보',a:2,t:'체력 2 회복, 1 피해, 카드 2장 뽑기. 10% 확률로 털보 1장 획득. 패에 염라가 있으면 50% 확률로 2장 더 뽑는다.'},
{id:'hb',n:'흑범호',a:3,t:'상대에게 2 피해. 내 체력이 5 이하면 2 추가 피해. 패에 단오가 있으면 체력 2 회복.'},
{id:'bul',n:'불괴',a:1,t:'상대에게 1 피해, 체력 2 회복. 다음 공격 1회를 무효화한다.'},
{id:'yw',n:'염라(왕년)',a:3,t:'상대에게 3 피해, 체력 1 회복. 30% 확률로 1 추가 피해. 패에 염라나 노망이 있으면 체력 1 회복. 카드 2장을 뽑고, 뽑은 카드에 염라·강림&지우·염라(왕년)·노망이 있으면 카드 2장 더 뽑고 1 피해. 이 공격으로 상대 체력이 3 미만이 되면 즉시 처치.'},
{id:'hw',n:'박현우',a:2,t:'체력 2 회복. 상대 패에서 랜덤 1장을 가져온다. 내 패에 서자빈이 있으면 상대에게 2 피해.'},
{id:'sd',n:'김시언(대부)',a:3,t:'체력 1 회복, 상대에게 3 피해. 카드 2장을 뽑고, 염라가 나오면 내 체력 1을 깎고 상대에게 1 피해.'},
{id:'mo',n:'적미람(원본)',a:3,t:'체력 1 회복. 상대를 매혹해 상대 패에서 공격력이 3번째로 높은 카드를 가져오고, 상대에게 2 피해. 패에 염라·염라(왕년)이 있으면 집착으로 체력 1 회복, 적미람이 있으면 격통 상태가 되어 상대에게 1 피해.'},
{id:'bw',n:'백우',a:1,t:'염라·백오수·강림&지우·김시언 4장 중 랜덤 1장을 가져온다. (덱 → 버림 더미 순으로 찾고, 없으면 새로 불러온다)'},
{id:'yuna',n:'박윤아',a:2,t:'카드 예시 3장 중 상대 패에 있는 카드를 1장 고른다. 맞히면 체력 2 회복, 상대에게 1 피해.'},
{id:'jiu',n:'이지우',a:2,t:'체력 2 회복. 상대에게 1 피해. 내게 1 피해 무효 보호막.'},
{id:'rim',n:'강림',a:3,t:'물보라를 일으켜 상대에게 2회 피해, 상대 카드 1장을 가져온다. 이어서 1 피해를 주고, 내 패에 염라가 있으면 1회 추가 피해 + 권능을 해방시켜 체력 2 회복.'},
{id:'cg',n:'청과',a:3,t:'여의주로 카드 1장 뽑고 체력 2 회복, 상대에게 2회 피해. 패에 강림 또는 강림&지우가 있으면 그 카드를 버리고 상대에게 2회 추가 피해, 여의주를 폭발시켜 체력 2회 회복. 여의주의 축복으로 다음 공격 1회를 무효화한다.'},
{id:'yg',n:'염라(소문의 괴이)',a:3,t:'돌려차기로 2회 피해, 연속 손톱 공격으로 87% 확률로 2회 추가 피해. 연못 속에 숨었다 튀어나와 1회 피해, 마비 공격으로 상대 카드 2장을 잠근다. 무리한 대가로 내 체력 2와 카드 1장을 잃는다. 패에 일식이 있으면 능력이 달라져 체력 3 회복, 기를 날려 1회 피해, 1회 회복.'},
{id:'ik',n:'일식(달)',a:3,t:'일식 검으로 상대에게 1 피해, 체력 1 회복. 패에 염라·염라(왕년)·염라(소문의 괴이)가 있으면 체력 1 회복 후 업도 상태가 되어 상대에게 3회 피해. 패에 염라·염라(왕년)·염라(흉년)·염라(야성)·염라(화왕지절)가 있으면 상대에게 \'업도 일식\'을 건다 — 내 다음 턴이 끝날 때까지 상대 체력이 2 미만이 되면 즉시 처치.'},
{id:'cg5',n:'청과(다섯개의 여의주의 주인)',a:3,t:'다섯 여의주로 상대에게 2회 피해, 체력 3회 회복. 대지: 카드 1장 뽑기. 물: 상대 카드 1장 확인. 불: 상대에게 1회 피해. 풀: 상대 카드 1장 가져오기(강림·강림&지우 우선). 패에 강림 또는 강림&지우가 있으면 그 카드를 제거하고 상대에게 1회 피해, 체력 1회 회복, 2회 보호막. 마지막으로 모든 여의주를 폭발시켜 5% 확률로 상대에게 2회 피해.'},
{id:'yh',n:'염라(흉년)',a:3,t:'상대에게 1회 피해. 상대 패가 3장 이상이면 2회 추가 피해. 수확으로 체력 2회 회복. 상대 패에 청과(다섯개의 여의주의 주인)가 있으면 그 카드를 삭제한다.'},
{id:'ya',n:'염라(야성)',a:3,t:'칼 두 자루를 던져 2회 피해. 검이 되돌아와 1회 피해. 호랑이의 기운으로 상대 카드 1장을 금지시킨다. 카드 1장을 뽑고, 뽑은 카드의 공격력이 2 이상이면 상대에게 1회 피해.'},
{id:'bom',n:'사계: 봄',a:3,t:'풀로 상대를 묶어 1회 피해. 꽃을 피워 체력 3회 회복. 펀치를 날려 2회 피해, 체력 2회 회복.'},
{id:'dbj',n:'동방삭(변장)',a:1,t:'체력 2 회복. 카드 1장을 얻는다.'},
{id:'hwj',n:'염라(화왕지절)',a:3,t:'주황빛으로 불타는 검기를 날려 상대에게 2회 피해. 내 체력이 3 이상이면 1회 추가 피해. 체력 2 회복. 패에 염라·염라(왕년)·염라(소문의 괴이)·염라(흉년)·염라(야성)가 있으면 적을 태워 1회 피해를 주고, 50% 확률로 상대 카드 2장을 가져온다.'},
{id:'ss',n:'염라(사사태아)',a:3,t:'커다란 뱀을 소환해 2회 피해. 50% 확률로 죽은 새끼 뱀을 소환해 체력 2회 회복 + 1회 피해. 패에 김시언이 있으면 1회 피해 후 독 바람 폭풍으로 상대 카드 3장을 가져오고 1회 피해, 체력 2 회복. 패에 김시언(대부)가 있으면 능력이 변해 체력 1 회복 후 김시언(대부)를 사용하고, 커다란 뱀이 사사태아(공격 1회 무효)를 부여한다.'},
{id:'sha',n:'샤샤',a:1,t:'상대에게 1회 피해. 패에 김시언, 김시언(대부), 염라(사사태아), 백우가 있는 경우 추가로 1회 피해를 준다.'},
{id:'tbn',n:'털보(염라)',a:3,t:'상대에게 2 피해, 결계(보호막 2)를 내린다. 상대가 나에게 4가 넘는 피해를 줬다면 상대에게 1 피해, 내가 상대에게 4가 넘는 피해를 줬다면 체력 2 회복. 둘 다라면 검기 2개로 불태워 2 피해를 주고, 권능을 내려 다음에 받는 피해만큼 2회 회복한다.'},
{id:'ybj',n:'염라(폭주)',a:3,t:'적에게 초록빛 지옥불을 1회 날린다. 내 체력이 5 미만이면 체력만큼 지옥불을 날린다. 50% 확률로 기운을 폭발시켜 1회 피해. 염라의 축복으로 다음에 뽑는 카드는 100% 염라 또는 염라 이격 캐릭터가 나온다.'},
{id:'gj',n:'견우&직녀',a:3,t:'적에게 2회 피해를 입힌 뒤 상대 패에서 공격력이 가장 높은 카드 2장을 다른 카드로 바꾼다. 낭군의 검기로 1회 피해를 입히고, 수의를 만들어 체력 3 회복. 견우와 직녀가 만나 오작교의 만남 효과(체력 1 회복)를 나만 받는다.'},
{id:'jiw',n:'이지우(원본)',a:2,t:'생선을 건져 체력을 2회 회복한 뒤, 발톱으로 할퀴어 50% 확률로 상대에게 2회 피해.'}];

function draw(s,n=1){let k=0;for(let i=0;i<n;i++){if(!s.deck.length){s.deck=sh(s.disc);s.disc=[]}if(!s.deck.length)break;let c;if(s.bless){s.bless=0;const Y=['yeom','yw','yg','yh','ya','hwj','ss','ybj'];let j=s.deck.findIndex(x=>Y.includes(x.id));if(j>=0)c=s.deck.splice(j,1)[0];else{j=s.disc.findIndex(x=>Y.includes(x.id));c=j>=0?s.disc.splice(j,1)[0]:{...C.find(x=>x.id===rnd(Y))};}log(`${who(s)}: 염라의 축복! ${c.n}을(를) 뽑았다`)}else c=s.deck.shift();c.lock=0;if(s.hand.length>=HL){s.disc.push(c);log(`${who(s)}: 패가 가득 차 ${c.n}이(가) 버려졌다`);continue}s.hand.push(c);k++}return k}

async function hit(s,n,pierce){proj(s);await sleep(300);const atk=s===G.p?G.e:G.p,ig=!!(atk&&atk.ign);if(ig&&(s.shield>0||s.barrier>0)){fl(s,'관통!','#ffd24a');log('⚔ 권능의 공격이 방어를 꿰뚫는다!');ring(s,'#ffd24a')}if(!ig&&s.shield>0){s.shield--;fl(s,'무효!','#8fd0ff');log('🛡 불괴의 몸! 공격이 무효화됐다');bn('不 壞');snd(700,.3,'square');render();await sleep(500);return}if(!ig&&s.barrier>0){const ab=Math.min(n,s.barrier);s.barrier-=ab;n-=ab;fl(s,'막음 '+ab,'#8fd0ff');log(`💠 보호막이 ${ab} 피해를 막았다`);snd(560,.2,'triangle');ring(s,'#8fd0ff');if(n<=0){render();await sleep(500);return}}if(!pierce){n=Math.min(n,CAP-s.taken);if(n<=0){fl(s,'결계!','#c9a0ff');log('저승의 결계가 막았다! (체력 ${s.hp})`);render();await sleep(500);if(s.yeop>0&&s.hp>0&&s.hp<2)await yeopExecute(s);if(s.gw&&s.hp>0){s.gw=0;fl(s,'權能','#cfe8ff');log('권능 발동! 받은 피해만큼 2회 회복');await heal(s,n);await heal(s,n)}}
async function heal(s,n){const b=s.hp;s.hp=Math.min(8,s.hp+n);if(s.hp>b){fl(s,'+'+(s.hp-b),'#6fff9a');snd(660,.3,'sine');burst(s,'#6fff9a');ring(s,'#6fff9a')}if(s.hp>b)log(`${who(s)} 체력 ${s.hp-b} 회복 (체력 ${s.hp})`);const el=$(s===G.p?'ps':'es');el.classList.remove('heal','flash');void el.offsetWidth;el.classList.add('heal');setTimeout(()=>el.classList.remove('heal'),650);render();await sleep(400)}

let bgT;function bgm(on){clearInterval(bgT);bgT=0;if(!on)return;const nt=[110,130.8,146.8,98];let i=0;bgT=setInterval(()=>{snd(nt[i++%4],1.8,'triangle',.03);if(i%3==0)snd(nt[(i+2)%4]*2,.6,'sine',.02)},1800)}
function proj(s){const a=$(s===G.p?'es':'ps').getBoundingClientRect(),b=$(s===G.p?'ps':'es').getBoundingClientRect(),e=document.createElement('i');e.className='pj';e.style.left=(a.left+a.width/2-14)+'px';e.style.top=(a.top+a.height/2-14)+'px';document.body.appendChild(e);requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>{e.style.transform=`translate(${b.left-a.left}px,${b.top-a.top}px) scale(1.5)`}));setTimeout(()=>{e.remove();const k=document.createElement('i');k.className='sl';k.style.left=(b.left+b.width/2-60)+'px';k.style.top=(b.top+b.height/2)+'px';document.body.appendChild(k);setTimeout(()=>k.remove(),350)},300)}
function burst(s,c){const r=(typeof s==='string'?$(s):$(s===G.p?'ps':'es')).getBoundingClientRect();for(let i=0;i<14;i++){const e=document.createElement('i');e.className='sp';const a=Math.random()*6.28,d=40+Math.random()*60;e.style.cssText=`left:${r.left+r.width/2}px;top:${r.top+r.height/2}px;background:${c};box-shadow:0 0 8px ${c};--x:${Math.cos(a)*d}px;--y:${Math.sin(a)*d}px`;document.body.appendChild(e);setTimeout(()=>e.remove(),750)}}
async function blast(me,foe){me.soul-=4;G.busy=true;render();bn('冥界開門');snd(180,.7,'sawtooth');log(`${who(me)}: 혼 폭발! 결계를 무시하고 1 피해, 카드 1장`);await sleep(900);await hit(foe,1,true);draw(me,1);render();if(G.p.hp<=0||G.e.hp<=0)return over();G.busy=false;render()}
const COMBOS=[{a:'jik',b:'gyeon',n:'오작교 재회!',f:async(me,foe)=>{await hit(foe,1);await heal(me,1)}},{a:'yeom',b:'no',n:'명부 열람!',f:async me=>{log(`${who(me)} 카드 ${draw(me,2)}장 추가 획득`)}},{a:'gang',b:'buri',n:'합동 공격!',f:async(me,foe)=>{await hit(foe,1)}}];

async function tideFx(foe,c1,c2,big){const cs=[c1,c2,'#fff'];flash(c1);whirl(foe);ripples(foe,c1);for(let i=0;i<(big?7:5);i++)setTimeout(()=>{colFx(foe,cs[i%3],(i-(big?3:2))*48);shw(foe,cs[(i+1)%3]);ring(foe,cs[i%3]);snd(300+i*90,.15,'triangle',.05)},i*80);bolts(foe,c1,big?14:10);parts(foe,'wp',cs,big?36:26);parts(foe,'rk',cs,big?24:16);shk();setTimeout(shk,180);if(big)setTimeout(shk,360);snd(70,.5,'sine',.12);snd(190,.3,'sawtooth',.07);await wt(420)}
async function godFx(me,c1,c2,txt){bn('權 能 解 放');stamp(txt||'權',c1,c2,300);flash(c1);for(let i=0;i<5;i++)setTimeout(()=>{colFx(me,i%2?'#fff':c1,(i-2)*40);ring(me,i%2?'#fff':c1);shw(me,c1)},i*100);spk(me,c1);spk(me,'#fff');parts(me,'rk',[c1,'#fff',c2],30);bolts(me,c1,12);burst(me,c1);burst(me,'#fff');snd(520,.4,'triangle',.06);snd(780,.5,'sine',.06);snd(1040,.6,'sine',.05);shk();await wt(520)}
const FX={
async jik(me,foe){if(!foe.hand.length)return log('상대 패가 없다');const mx=Math.max(...foe.hand.map(c=>c.a));const i=foe.hand.findIndex(c=>c.a===mx);const out=foe.hand[i];const pool=foe.deck.map((c,k)=>k).filter(k=>foe.deck[k].id!==out.id);if(!pool.length)return log('교체할 카드가 없다');const k=rnd(pool);const inc=foe.deck[k];foe.deck[k]=out;foe.hand[i]=inc;log(`${who(foe)}의 ${out.n}(${out.a})이 ${inc.n}(으)로 교체됨`)},
async gyeon(me,foe){await hit(foe,1);if(foe.hp<=0)return;const take=async c=>{foe.hand.splice(foe.hand.indexOf(c),1);c.lock=0;render();snd(520,.3,'triangle');await fly(c,foe===G.p?'hand':'eb',me===G.p?'hand':'eb');me.hand.push(c);log(`${who(me)}: ${who(foe)}의 ${c.n}을(를) 가져왔다`);render();await sleep(400)};const z=foe.hand.filter(c=>c.a===0);if(z.length)await take(rnd(z));else log('전투력 0 카드가 없다');if(me.hand.some(c=>c.id==='jik')&&foe.hand.length){bn('烏 鵲');log('직녀의 힘으로 한 장 더!');await take(rnd(foe.hand))}},
async ilsik(me,foe){if(await coin()){log(`${who(me)} 카드 ${draw(me,2)}장 획득`)}else{log('뒷면! 상대에게 1회 피해');await hit(foe,1)}},
async jeje(me,foe){if(!(await coin())){if(!me.hand.length)return log('버릴 카드가 없다');let i=0;if(me===G.p){i=await pick('버릴 카드를 고르세요',me.hand,true)}else i=me.hand.indexOf(me.hand.slice().sort((a,b)=>a.a-b.a)[0]);const c=me.hand.splice(i,1)[0];me.disc.push(c);log(`${c.n} 버림`);render();bn('齊 天');stamp('齊','#ffd24a','#c9801a',260);colFx(me,'#ffd24a');await wt(450);slam(foe,'#ffd24a',5);await hit(foe,2)}else{log('불발! 대신 카드 1장을 얻는다');stamp('雲','#fff2a8','#c9801a',200);spk(me,'#ffd24a');ring(me,'#ffd24a');parts(me,'rk',['#ffd24a','#fff'],14);draw(me,1)}},
async buri(me,foe){await hit(foe,1)},
async cleo(me){draw(me,0);if(me.deck.length<2&&me.disc.length){me.deck.push(...sh(me.disc));me.disc=[]}const t=me.deck.splice(0,2);if(!t.length)return log('덱이 비었다');const i=t.length>1?await pick('1장을 가져오세요',t,me===G.p):0;t[i].lock=0;me.hand.push(t[i]);t.splice(i,1);me.deck.push(...t);log(`${who(me)} 카드 1장 선택`)},
async yeom(me,foe){const weak=me.hand.some(c=>['jiu','rim','no','gang'].includes(c.id));if(weak)log('이지우·강림·노망이 곁에 있다… 피해가 1회로 줄어든다');const n=weak?1:2;for(let i=0;i<2;i++){if(i<n&&foe.hp>0)await hit(foe,1);await heal(me,1)}if(me.hand.some(c=>c.id==='ilsik')){bn('怪 異');snd(120,.6,'sawtooth');log('일식이 곁에 있다… 괴이 상태!');await sleep(600);log(`${who(me)} 카드 ${draw(me,1)}장 획득`)}},
async gang(me,foe){await FX.gang0(me,foe);if(G.over||me.hp<=0)return;await godFx(me,'#ffd24a','#c9801a','權');log('권능을 해방한다!');await heal(me,3);me.ignN=true;stamp('貫','#fff','#ff8a1a',280);flash('#ffd24a');ring(me,'#ffd24a');ring(me,'#fff');spk(me,'#ffd24a');fl(me,'⚔ 관통 준비','#ffd24a');log(`${who(me)}: 다음 턴의 공격은 불괴·보호막을 무시한다`);render();await sleep(400)},
async gang0(me,foe){stamp('水','#7fe','#0a8a88',300);flash('#7fe');await tideFx(foe,'#7fe','#6fb7ff',true);whirl(foe);ripples(foe,'#7fe');parts(foe,'wp',['#6fb7ff','#bfe4ff','#fff'],22);slashC(foe,0,'#7fe');slashC(foe,1,'#6fb7ff');shk();await wt(250);slam(foe,'#7fe',5);await hit(foe,2);if(foe.hp<=0)return;if(!foe.hand.length)return log('가져올 카드가 없다');const i=foe.hand.findIndex(c=>c.id==='yeom'),c=foe.hand.splice(i>=0?i:Math.random()*foe.hand.length|0,1)[0];c.lock=0;render();bn('水 飛');await comet(foe,me,'#7fe');snd(520,.4,'triangle');await fly(c,foe===G.p?'hand':'eb',me===G.p?'hand':'eb');me.hand.push(c);ring(me,'#7fe');parts(me,'wp',['#6fb7ff','#bfe4ff','#fff'],16);log(`${who(me)}: 물보라! ${who(foe)}의 ${c.n}을(를) 가져왔다`);render();await sleep(500);if(c.id==='yeom'){log('염라를 빼앗았다! 추가 피해 + 보호막');await hit(foe,1);me.barrier=Math.min(4,(me.barrier||0)+2);fl(me,'💠+2','#8fd0ff');ring(me,'#8fd0ff');ring(me,'#fff');colFx(me,'#8fd0ff');parts(me,'rk',['#8fd0ff','#fff'],14);stamp('護','#cfeaff','#3a7aff',200);log(`${who(me)}에게 2 피해 무효 보호막`);render();await sleep(500)}},
async jiu(me,foe){await heal(me,2);await hit(foe,1);me.barrier=Math.min(4,(me.barrier||0)+1);fl(me,'💠+1','#8fd0ff');ring(me,'#8fd0ff');log(`${who(me)}에게 1 피해 무효 보호막`);render();await sleep(400)},
async rim(me,foe){bn('降 臨');stamp('降','#cfe8ff','#3a7aff',300);flash('#9fd0ff');colFx(foe,'#9fd0ff');bolts(foe,'#9fd0ff',9);slashC(foe,0,'#9fd0ff');shk();await wt(300);log('물보라가 일어난다!');await tideFx(foe,'#6fb7ff','#bfe4ff',false);await hit(foe,1);if(foe.hp>0){slashC(foe,1,'#6fb7ff');slashC(foe,3,'#fff');shk();await tideFx(foe,'#9fd0ff','#fff',false);await hit(foe,1)}if(foe.hp<=0)return;if(foe.hand.length){const c=foe.hand.splice(Math.random()*foe.hand.length|0,1)[0];c.lock=0;render();bn('水 飛');await comet(foe,me,'#9fd0ff');snd(520,.4,'triangle');await fly(c,foe===G.p?'hand':'eb',me===G.p?'hand':'eb');me.hand.push(c);ring(me,'#9fd0ff');parts(me,'wp',['#6fb7ff','#fff'],14);log(`${who(me)}: ${who(foe)}의 ${c.n}을(를) 가져왔다`);render();await sleep(400)}else log('가져올 카드가 없다');stamp('波','#bfe4ff','#3a7aff',260);slam(foe,'#9fd0ff',4);slashC(foe,2,'#cfe8ff');await wt(250);await hit(foe,1);if(foe.hp>0&&me.hand.some(c=>c.id==='yeom')){bn('閻 羅');stamp('閻','#ff4a5a','#7a0010',260);flash('#ff2a3a');slam(foe,'#ff4a5a',4);slashC(foe,2,'#ff2a3a');slashC(foe,0,'#fff');log('염라가 곁에 있다… 추가 피해, 권능 해방!');await sleep(400);await hit(foe,1)}if(me.hand.some(c=>c.id==='yeom')){await godFx(me,'#ffd24a','#c9801a','權');await heal(me,2)}},
async si(me,foe){await heal(me,2);log(`${who(me)} 카드 ${draw(me,2)}장 뽑음`);render();await sleep(300);bn('大 蛇');log('커다란 뱀이 나타났다!');log('뱀이 상대를 꿀꺽 삼켰다!');ring(foe,'#4f8');burst(foe,'#4f8');snd(150,.35,'square');await hit(foe,1);if(foe.hp>0&&foe.hand.length){const c=foe.hand.splice(Math.random()*foe.hand.length|0,1)[0];c.lock=0;render();await fly(c,foe===G.p?'hand':'eb',me===G.p?'hand':'eb');me.hand.push(c);log(`${who(me)}: 뱀이 ${who(foe)}의 ${c.n}을(를) 물어왔다`);render();await sleep(400)}},
async yh(me,foe){const many=foe.hand.length>=3,dk=yhDark(foe);try{bn('凶 年');log('흉년의 낫이 드리운다…');yhStamp('凶');yhAsh(46);snd(60,1.2,'sine',.14);hgFx(foe,-22);snd(190,.3,'sawtooth');await wt(520);yhSlash(foe,0);shk();await hit(foe,1);
if(many&&foe.hp>0){log('적의 패가 풍성하다! 2회 추가 피해');await wt(200);bn('大 凶');yhStamp('荒');for(let i=0;i<2&&foe.hp>0;i++){hgFx(foe,-50+i*60);await wt(170);yhSlash(foe,i+1);shk();setTimeout(shk,160);await hit(foe,1)}}
if(foe.hp<=0)return;const dm=dimOn(me);dm.style.background='radial-gradient(circle,rgba(60,0,10,.2),rgba(10,0,4,.78))';try{bn('收 穫');log('수확! 낫이 곡식을 벤다');await harvestFx(me);yhDrain(foe,me);await wt(1000);log('생명이 수확되어 흘러든다…');await heal(me,1);await heal(me,1)}finally{dimOff(dm)}
const k=foe.hand.findIndex(c=>c.id==='cg5');if(k>=0){foe.hand.splice(k,1);bn('削 除');yhStamp('削');log(`${who(foe)}의 청과(다섯개의 여의주의 주인)가 삭제되었다!`);yhSlash(foe,3);flash('#8a1226');burst(foe,'#8a1226');ring(foe,'#8a1226');shk();render();await sleep(700)}}finally{dimOff(dk)}},
async ya(me,foe){const dk=dimOn(foe);dk.style.background='radial-gradient(circle,rgba(10,90,76,.3),rgba(0,12,12,.85))';try{bn('野 性');stamp('野','#7ff2d6','#0a8a70',260);log('칼 두 자루를 던진다!');snd(70,.8,'sine',.12);colFx(me,'#3ad6b0',-50);colFx(me,'#bffff0',50);bolts(me,'#3ad6b0',9);parts(me,'rk',['#3ad6b0','#bffff0'],16);await wt(450);
for(let i=0;i<2&&foe.hp>0;i++){await yaSword(me,foe,i);await hit(foe,1)}
if(foe.hp<=0)return;bn('回 劍');log('검이 되돌아와 베어낸다!');qiWave(foe);slashC(foe,0,'#3ad6b0');slashC(foe,3,'#bffff0');shk();await wt(250);const bk=yaBack(me,foe);await hit(foe,1);await bk}finally{dimOff(dk)}
if(foe.hp<=0)return;bn('虎 氣');log('호랑이의 기운이 일렁인다…');tigerFx();stamp('虎','#7ff2d6','#0a8a70',210);flash('#3ad6b0');await wt(450);
const t=foe.hand.filter(c=>!c.lock).sort((a,b)=>b.a-a.a)[0];if(t){t.lock=1;log(`${who(foe)}의 ${t.n} 금지! (다음 턴 사용 불가)`);ring(foe,'#3ad6b0');ring(foe,'#bffff0');burst(foe,'#3ad6b0');bolts(foe,'#bffff0',9);render();await sleep(500)}else log('금지시킬 카드가 없다');
const n=me.hand.length;draw(me,1);const d=me.hand.slice(n);render();if(d.length){log(`${who(me)} 카드 1장 뽑음: ${d[0].n} (공격력 ${d[0].a})`);if(d[0].a>=2&&foe.hp>0){bn('野 牙');log('뽑은 카드가 강하다! 호랑이의 송곳니가 파고든다');qiWave(foe);slashC(foe,1,'#3ad6b0');slashC(foe,2,'#bffff0');shk();await wt(300);await hit(foe,1)}}else log('카드를 뽑지 못했다')},
async bom(me,foe){const dk=dimOn(me);dk.style.background='radial-gradient(circle,rgba(150,50,100,.22),rgba(20,6,16,.8))';try{bn('四 季');stamp('春','#ffb7d5','#d04a8a',260);log('봄의 기운이 퍼진다…');await wt(500);
bn('縛 草');log('풀이 상대를 휘감는다!');vines(foe,'#3fbf6a');parts(foe,'lf',['#7be0a0','#3fbf6a','#b8f08a'],18);colFx(foe,'#3fbf6a');snd(300,.4,'triangle',.07);await wt(700);shk();await hit(foe,1);if(foe.hp<=0)return;
bn('開 花');log('꽃이 만개한다! 체력 회복');bloomFx();await wt(900);for(let i=0;i<3;i++)await heal(me,1);
bn('春 拳');log('봄의 주먹!');for(let i=0;i<2&&foe.hp>0;i++){await punchFx(me,foe,i);await hit(foe,1)}
if(foe.hp<=0)return;log('주먹에 봄의 기운이 깃든다… 체력 회복');spk(me,'#ffb7d5');for(let i=0;i<2;i++)await heal(me,1)}finally{dimOff(dk)}},
async dbj(me,foe){bn('變 裝');stamp('變','#d8b8ff','#6a3aff',230);log('변장을 풀고 숨을 고른다…');colFx(me,'#b070ff');bolts(me,'#b070ff',6);ring(me,'#b070ff');ring(me,'#fff');burst(me,'#b070ff');parts(me,'wp',['#b070ff','#d8b8ff','#fff'],16);snd(420,.3,'triangle',.07);await wt(500);await heal(me,2);spk(me,'#d8b8ff');log(`${who(me)} 카드 ${draw(me,1)}장 획득`);render();await sleep(400)},
async hwj(me,foe){bn('火 王 劍 氣');stamp('火','#ffb04a','#a02a00',220);colFx(me,'#ff8a1a');ring(me,'#ff8a1a');parts(me,'fp',['#ff5a0a','#ffb02a'],10);log('주황빛 검기가 불타오른다!');await wt(550);fqFx(foe,-25);slashC(foe,0,'#ff8a1a');shk();await wt(200);await hit(foe,1);if(foe.hp>0){fqFx(foe,20);slashC(foe,2,'#ffd24a');shk();await wt(200);await hit(foe,1)}if(foe.hp<=0)return;if(me.hp>=3){bn('追 擊');log('체력이 3 이상… 검기가 한 번 더 내리친다!');fqFx(foe,-60);setTimeout(()=>fqFx(foe,40),120);colFx(foe,'#ff8a1a');shk();await wt(300);await hit(foe,1);if(foe.hp<=0)return}ring(me,'#ffd24a');parts(me,'fp',['#ffd24a','#ff8a1a'],8);await heal(me,2);const W=['yeom','yw','yg','yh','ya'];if(foe.hp>0&&me.hand.some(c=>W.includes(c.id))){bn('燒');stamp('燒','#ff3a1a','#7a0010',220);log('염라의 기운이 곁에 있다… 적을 불태운다!');parts(foe,'fp',['#ff3a1a','#ff8a1a','#ffd24a'],22);colFx(foe,'#ff5a0a');burst(foe,'#ff8a1a');shk();await wt(350);await hit(foe,1);if(foe.hp>0){if(Math.random()<.5){let g=0;for(let k=0;k<2&&foe.hand.length;k++){const c=foe.hand.splice(Math.random()*foe.hand.length|0,1)[0];c.lock=0;render();await comet(foe,me,'#ffb04a');await fly(c,foe===G.p?'hand':'eb',me===G.p?'hand':'eb');me.hand.push(c);g++;log(`${who(me)}: ${who(foe)}의 ${c.n}을(를) 불꽃으로 낚아챘다`);render();await wt(300)}if(!g)log('빼앗을 카드가 없다')}else log('불꽃이 스쳐갔다… 카드를 얻지 못했다')}}},
async cg5(me,foe){bn('五 珠');stamp('五','#6fe8d8','#0a8a88',260);log('다섯 개의 여의주가 떠오른다!');const dm=dimOn(me),mg=magic(me),w=orbit5(me),off=i=>w.children[i]&&w.children[i].classList.add('off');try{colFx(me,'#6fe8d8');shk();await wt(950);
await comet(me,foe,'#6fe8d8');shw(foe,'#6fe8d8');await hit(foe,1);if(foe.hp>0){await comet(me,foe,'#fff');shw(foe,'#fff');shk();await hit(foe,1)}if(foe.hp<=0)return;

off(0);bn('大 地');shk();colFx(me,'#ffd24a');bolts(me,'#ffd24a',7);parts(me,'rk',['#ffd24a','#c9a23a'],12);ring(me,'#ffd24a');ring(me,'#ffe08a');snd(80,.5,'sine',.1);log(`대지의 힘! 카드 ${draw(me,1)}장 뽑음`);render();await wt(700);

async ik(me,foe){bn('日 蝕 劍');stamp('蝕','#ffd878','#ff8a1a');log('일식 검! 검은 검기가 베어낸다');eclipse(foe);await wt(550);kgFx(foe,-25);snd(200,.3,'sawtooth');slashC(foe,0,'#ffd878');shk();await wt(200);await hit(foe,1);await heal(me,1);if(foe.hp>0&&me.hand.some(c=>['yeom','yw','yg'].includes(c.id))){await heal(me,1);bn('業 刀');stamp('業','#d8c8ff','#6a3aff',260);log('염라의 업이 깃든다… 업도 상태!');colFx(me,'#8a6bff',-70);colFx(me,'#ffd878');colFx(me,'#8a6bff',70);bolts(me,'#b070ff',10);parts(me,'rk',['#8a6bff','#ffd878','#1a0a3a'],22);ring(me,'#8a6bff');ring(me,'#ffd878');snd(70,1,'sine',.14);await wt(500);await moonFx(foe);for(let i=0;i<3&&foe.hp>0;i++){kgFx(foe,-40+i*40);slashC(foe,i,i==2?'#ffd878':'#b070ff');colFx(foe,'#ffd878',(i-1)*50);flash(i==2?'#fff':'#8a6bff');shk();setTimeout(shk,150);await hit(foe,1)}if(foe.hp>0){eclipse(foe);await wt(300)}}

async yg(me,foe){if(me.hand.some(c=>c.id==='ilsik')){bn('怪 氣');stamp('怪','#ff4a5a','#5a0010',270);log('일식이 곁에 있다… 괴이한 기운이 깨어나 능력이 달라진다!');const dk=dimOn(me);dk.style.background='radial-gradient(circle,rgba(120,0,20,.3),rgba(8,0,3,.86))';try{yhAsh(32);snd(60,1.2,'sine',.14);parts(me,'fp',['#ff2a3a','#8a0a1e','#1a0206'],26);colFx(me,'#c8203a',-60);colFx(me,'#ff4a5a');colFx(me,'#c8203a',60);bolts(me,'#ff2a3a',10);ring(me,'#c8203a');ring(me,'#ff4a5a');await wt(750);bn('吸 氣');log('괴이한 기운을 빨아들여 체력 회복');gwiMist(me);await wt(1000);await heal(me,3);bn('氣 功');log('기를 날린다!');await gwiBlast(me,foe);await hit(foe,1);await heal(me,1)}finally{dimOff(dk)}return}

if(foe.hp>0){bn('裂 爪');log('연속 손톱 공격!');stamp('爪','#ff2a3a','#3a0008',270);const dk2=dimOn(me);dk2.style.background='radial-gradient(circle,rgba(120,0,20,.28),rgba(6,0,2,.88))';try{yhAsh(24);snd(70,.9,'sine',.12);for(let q=0;q<3;q++)setTimeout(()=>{clawFx(foe);slashC(foe,q,q==1?'#1a0206':'#ff2a3a');colFx(foe,q==1?'#8a0a1e':'#ff2a3a',(q-1)*46);shk()},q*170);parts(foe,'fp',['#ff2a3a','#8a0a1e','#1a0206'],30);bolts(foe,'#ff2a3a',12);await wt(800);if(Math.random()<.87){log('급소를 찢었다! 2회 추가 피해');bn('急 所');stamp('裂','#ff4a5a','#1a0206',280);flash('#ff2a3a');flash('#1a0206');for(let q=0;q<2&&foe.hp>0;q++){clawFx(foe);slashC(foe,q+2,'#ff2a3a');slam(foe,'#8a0a1e',3);bolts(foe,'#ff4a5a',8);parts(foe,'fp',['#ff2a3a','#1a0206'],16);shk();await wt(220);await hit(foe,1)}}else log('손톱이 빗나갔다')}finally{dimOff(dk2)}}
if(foe.hp<=0)return;const mine=$(me===G.p?'ps':'es');bn('潛 行');log('연못 속으로 잠수…');yhAsh(16);flash('#1a0206');mine.classList.add('dive');for(let i=0;i<3;i++)setTimeout(()=>ring(me,'#8a0a1e'),i*220);ripples(me,'#8a0a1e');parts(me,'fp',['#ff2a3a','#8a0a1e','#1a0206'],20);await wt(900);mine.classList.remove('dive');mine.classList.add('emerge');setTimeout(()=>mine.classList.remove('emerge'),700);log('연못에서 튀어나와 기습!');snd(420,.3,'triangle');ring(me,'#ff2a3a');burst(me,'#ff2a3a');burst(me,'#1a0206');colFx(me,'#ff2a3a');shw(me,'#ff2a3a');ripples(me,'#c8203a');parts(me,'fp',['#ff2a3a','#8a0a1e','#1a0206','#ff6a6a'],34);flash('#ff2a3a');flash('#1a0206');bolts(me,'#ff2a3a',12);slam(me,'#8a0a1e',3);yhAsh(18);shk();setTimeout(shk,160);stamp('躍','#ff9a9a','#3a0008',230);await wt(250);slashC(foe,1,'#ff2a3a');await hit(foe,1);
if(foe.hp<=0)return;const t=sh(foe.hand.filter(c=>!c.lock)).slice(0,2);t.forEach(c=>c.lock=1);if(t.length){bn('痲 痺');log(`마비 공격! ${who(foe)}의 ${t.map(c=>c.n).join('·')} 잠금`);ring(foe,'#8a0a1e');burst(foe,'#8a0a1e');bolts(foe,'#8a0a1e',10);colFx(foe,'#8a0a1e');flash('#8a0a1e');flash('#1a0206');yhAsh(14);slam(foe,'#8a0a1e',3);shk();stamp('痲','#ff4a5a','#3a0008',230);render();await sleep(600)}

async cg(me,foe){bn('如 意 珠');log(`${who(me)}: 여의주가 빛난다! 카드 ${draw(me,1)}장 뽑음`);render();await heal(me,2);await pearlFx(me,foe);flash('#6ff');shw(foe,'#6ff');bolts(foe,'#6ff',9);parts(foe,'wp',['#6fe8d8','#bfffff'],16);shk();await hit(foe,1);if(foe.hp>0){shw(foe,'#fff');bolts(foe,'#fff',7);slashC(foe,1,'#6ff');shk();await hit(foe,1)}const i=[me.hand.findIndex(c=>c.id==='rim'),me.hand.findIndex(c=>c.id==='gang')].find(x=>x>=0)??-1;if(i>=0&&foe.hp>0){const c=me.hand.splice(i,1)[0];me.disc.push(c);render();log(`${c.n}을(를) 제물로 바치자 여의주가 폭주한다!`);bn('珠 爆');stamp('爆','#fff','#2ad',280);await pearlBurst(me);for(let j=0;j<5;j++)setTimeout(()=>{colFx(foe,'#6fe8d8',(j-2)*55);shw(foe,j%2?'#fff':'#6ff')},j*90);bolts(foe,'#6ff',12);parts(foe,'wp',['#6fe8d8','#bfffff','#fff'],24);shk();setTimeout(shk,250);await hit(foe,1);if(foe.hp>0)await hit(foe,1);await heal(me,1);await heal(me,1);me.shield=1;fl(me,'축복','#8ff');ring(me,'#8ff');ring(me,'#fff');colFx(me,'#8ff');parts(me,'rk',['#8ff','#fff'],16);stamp('祝','#bff','#2ad',200);log(`${who(me)}에게 여의주의 축복! 다음 공격 1회 무효`);render();await sleep(500)}},
async dan(me,foe){await hit(foe,2);const t=sh([...foe.hand]).slice(0,2);if(!t.length)return log('확인할 카드가 없다');if(me===G.p){await pick('적의 카드 2장 확인 (눌러서 닫기)',t,true)}else log('적이 내 패 2장을 엿보았다')},
async dong(me,foe){const had=me.hand.some(c=>c.id==='so');bn('東 方');stamp('東','#ffe08a','#a06a1a',260);colFx(me,'#ffe08a');await wt(500);slam(foe,'#ffe08a',5);await hit(foe,3);me.hand.push({...C.find(c=>c.id==='so'),lock:0});log(`${who(me)}: 금소원 카드를 얻었다`);spk(me,'#ffe08a');ring(me,'#ffe08a');parts(me,'rk',['#ffe08a','#fff'],12);render();if(had&&foe.hp>0){log('금소원이 곁에 있었다… 추가 피해');slashC(foe,1,'#ffe08a');shk();await sleep(400);await hit(foe,1)}},

async hm(me){await heal(me,3);if(Math.random()<.3){log('행운! 추가 회복');await heal(me,1)}},
async tbo(me,foe){await heal(me,2);await hit(foe,1);let n=2;if(me.hand.some(c=>c.id==='yeom')&&Math.random()<.5){n=4;log('염라의 가호! 카드 2장 추가')}log(`${who(me)} 카드 ${draw(me,n)}장 뽑음`);if(Math.random()<.1){me.hand.push({...C.find(c=>c.id==='tbo')});log('털보가 한 명 더 나타났다!')}},
async hb(me,foe){bn('猛 虎');stamp('虎','#ffb040','#a02a00',250);clawFx(foe);slashC(foe,0,'#ffb040');slashC(foe,2,'#ff6a2b');shk();await wt(350);await hit(foe,2);if(me.hp<=5){log('분노!');stamp('怒','#ff3a2a','#7a0010',260);yhAsh(26);flash('#ff3a2a');colFx(me,'#ff3a2a');clawFx(foe);slashC(foe,1,'#ff3a2a');slashC(foe,3,'#ff6a2b');shk();setTimeout(shk,180);await wt(300);await hit(foe,2)}if(me.hand.some(c=>c.id==='dan')){log('단오와 함께라면…');spk(me,'#6fff9a');ring(me,'#6fff9a');colFx(me,'#6fff9a');await heal(me,2)}},

async yw(me,foe){const b=foe.hp;bn('往 年');stamp('往','#ff4a5a','#7a0010',250);hgFx(foe,-30);yhAsh(24);await wt(450);slashC(foe,0,'#ff2a3a');slashC(foe,3,'#c01830');shk();await hit(foe,3);await heal(me,1);if(foe.hp>0&&Math.random()<.3){log('왕년의 일격! 추가 피해');slashC(foe,2,'#fff');shk();await hit(foe,1)}

async oh(me,foe){await heal(me,2);const t=foe.hand.filter(c=>!c.lock);if(t.length){const c=rnd(t);c.lock=1;log(`${who(foe)}의 ${c.n} 잠금! (다음 턴 사용 불가)`)}else log('잠글 카드가 없다')},

async so(me){log(`${who(me)} 카드 ${draw(me,1)}장 뽑음`);if(await coin())log(`행운! 카드 ${draw(me,1)}장 더`)},
async mi(me,foe){await hit(foe,1);if(foe.hp>0&&Math.random()<.4){log('추가 타격!');await hit(foe,1);if(foe.hp>0&&Math.random()<.2){log('연속 타격!');await hit(foe,1)}}if(Math.random()<.1)await heal(me,1)},
async rang(me,foe){await hit(foe,1);if(foe.hp>0&&me.hand.some(c=>c.id==='mi')){bn('兄 弟');snd(440,.5,'square');log('형제 상태! 연속 공격');await sleep(700);await hit(foe,1);if(foe.hp>0)await hit(foe,1);await heal(me,1)}},
async no(me){let n=1+(me.hand.some(c=>c.id==='yeom')?1:0);log(`${who(me)} 카드 ${draw(me,n)}장 획득`)},
async hw(me,foe){await heal(me,2);if(foe.hand.length){const c=foe.hand.splice(Math.random()*foe.hand.length|0,1)[0];c.lock=0;render();await fly(c,foe===G.p?'hand':'eb',me===G.p?'hand':'eb');me.hand.push(c);log(`${who(me)}: ${who(foe)}의 ${c.n} 탈취!`)}else log('가져올 카드가 없다');if(me.hand.some(c=>c.id==='ja')){log('서자빈이 곁에 있다… 일격!');await hit(foe,2)}},
async sd(me,foe){bn('大 父');stamp('父','#ffd878','#3a2a00',250);await heal(me,1);for(let i=0;i<3;i++){flash('#ffd878');slashC(foe,i,'#ffd878');snd(220,.12,'square',.09);await wt(130)}shk();slam(foe,'#ffd878',3);await hit(foe,3);const n=me.hand.length;draw(me,2);const d=me.hand.slice(n);log(`${who(me)} 카드 ${d.length}장 뽑음`);if(d.some(c=>c.id==='yeom')){bn('代 價');snd(140,.5,'sawtooth');stamp('代','#ff4a3a','#7a0010',200);flash('#ff3a2a');log('염라가 나왔다! 피의 대가…');me.hp=Math.max(1,me.hp-1);fl(me,'-1','#ff4a3a');render();await sleep(600);if(foe.hp>0)await hit(foe,1)}},
async mo(me,foe){await heal(me,1);if(foe.hand.length){const s=foe.hand.slice().sort((a,b)=>b.a-a.a);const c=s[Math.min(2,s.length-1)];foe.hand.splice(foe.hand.indexOf(c),1);c.lock=0;render();await fly(c,foe===G.p?'hand':'eb',me===G.p?'hand':'eb');me.hand.push(c);bn('魅 惑');snd(520,.5,'triangle');stamp('魅','#ff7ac8','#a01a6a',250);ring(me,'#ff7ac8');ring(foe,'#ff7ac8');parts(foe,'lf',['#ff7ac8','#ffb7c9','#fff'],22);parts(me,'lf',['#ff7ac8','#ffb7c9'],16);colFx(foe,'#ff7ac8');flash('#ff7ac8');log(`${who(me)}: 매혹! ${who(foe)}의 ${c.n}을(를) 가져왔다`);render();await sleep(600)}else log('매혹할 카드가 없다');slashC(foe,0,'#ff7ac8');slashC(foe,1,'#ff4a8a');shk();await wt(200);await hit(foe,2);if(me.hand.some(c=>c.id==='yeom'||c.id==='yw')){log('집착…!');await heal(me,1)}if(foe.hp>0&&me.hand.some(c=>c.id==='mi')){bn('激 痛');snd(90,.6,'sawtooth');stamp('激','#ff4a5a','#7a0010',230);slam(foe,'#ff4a5a',3);log('격통 상태! 추가 피해');await sleep(500);await hit(foe,1)}},
async yuna(me,foe){const ids=[...new Set(foe.hand.map(c=>c.id))];const real=ids.length?rnd(ids):null;const dec=sh(C.filter(c=>!ids.includes(c.id)&&c.id!=='yuna')).slice(0,real?2:3);const opts=sh([...(real?[C.find(c=>c.id===real)]:[]),...dec].map(c=>({...c,lock:0})));let i;if(me===G.p)i=await pick('상대 패에 있는 카드를 고르세요',opts,true);else i=Math.random()*opts.length|0;const c=opts[i];if(foe.hand.some(x=>x.id===c.id)){bn('適 中');snd(660,.4,'triangle');log(`${who(me)}: ${c.n} 적중! 상대 패에 있었다`);await sleep(500);await heal(me,2);if(foe.hp>0)await hit(foe,1)}else{bn('不 中');snd(200,.3,'square');log(`${who(me)}: ${c.n}… 빗나갔다`);fl(me,'빗나감','#c9b88f');await sleep(700)}},

function whoosh(d=.25,f=1400){try{AC=AC||new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();if(AC.state==='suspended')AC.resume();const n=AC.sampleRate*d|0,b=AC.createBuffer(1,n,AC.sampleRate),a=b.getChannelData(0);for(let i=0;i<n;i++)a[i]=(Math.random()*2-1)*(1-i/n);const s=AC.createBufferSource(),q=AC.createBiquadFilter(),g=AC.createGain();s.buffer=b;q.type='bandpass';q.frequency.setValueAtTime(f,AC.currentTime);q.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(f/5,AC.currentTime+d);g.gain.value=.09;s.connect(q);q.connect(g);g.connect(AC.destination);s.start()}catch(e){}}

function score(c,me,foe){let s=Math.random()*[6,1.5,.3][S.df??1];if(c.id==='dbj')s+=me.hp<=5?4:2.5;if(c.id==='bom')s+=me.hp<=5?8:5;if(c.id==='ya')s+=foe.hp<=4?8:5.5;if(c.id==='hwj')s+=(foe.hp<=4?9:6)+(me.hand.some(x=>['yeom','yw','yg','yh','ya'].includes(x.id))?2:0);if(c.id==='gang')s+=foe.hp<=3?9:4+(foe.hand.some(x=>x.id==='yeom')?2:0);if(c.id==='jiu')s+=me.hp<=5?4:3;if(c.id==='rim')s+=foe.hp<=2?9:4.5;if(c.id==='buri')s+=foe.hp<=1?9:2;if(c.id==='yeom')s+=foe.hp<=1?9:3+(me.hp<8?1:0);if(c.id==='si')s+=me.hp<=3?6:4;if(c.id==='yh')s+=foe.hand.some(x=>x.id==='cg5')?9:(foe.hand.length>=3?6:4);if(c.id==='cg5')s+=(me.hand.some(x=>x.id==='rim')||foe.hand.some(x=>x.id==='rim')?8:5.5);if(c.id==='ik')s+=(me.hand.some(x=>['yeom','yw','yg'].includes(x.id))?7:3.5)+(foe.hp<=4?2:0);if(c.id==='yg')s+=(foe.hp<=4?8:4.5)+(me.hand.some(x=>x.id==='ilsik')?1:0);if(c.id==='cg')s+=me.hand.some(x=>x.id==='rim')?8:4.5;if(c.id==='jeje')s+=me.hand.length>1?2.5:-2;if(c.id==='jik')s+=foe.hand.some(x=>x.a>=3)?4:1.5;if(c.id==='gyeon')s+=2+(foe.hand.some(x=>x.a===0)?2:0)+(me.hand.some(x=>x.id==='jik')?1.5:0);if(c.id==='ja')s+=me.hp<=2?5:2;if(c.id==='oh')s+=me.hp<=5?3:1.5;if(c.id==='da')s+=2.5;if(c.id==='so')s+=1.5;if(c.id==='mi')s+=3;if(c.id==='rang')s+=me.hand.some(x=>x.id==='mi')?7:2;if(c.id==='dan')s+=3.5;if(c.id==='dong')s+=foe.hp<=3?9:4;if(c.id==='kka')s+=3;if(c.id==='hm')s+=me.hp<=5?3.5:.5;if(c.id==='tbo')s+=3;if(c.id==='hb')s+=me.hp<=5?6:4;if(c.id==='bul')s+=me.shield?0:3.5;if(c.id==='yw')s+=foe.hp<=4?9:5;if(c.id==='hw')s+=me.hand.some(x=>x.id==='ja')?6:3.5;if(c.id==='sd')s+=foe.hp<=3?9:5;if(c.id==='mo')s+=foe.hp<=2?9:4.5;if(c.id==='bw')s+=me.hand.length<6?3.5:1;if(c.id==='yuna')s+=3;return s+1}

 snd(660,.6,'sine',.05);setTimeout(()=>snd(990,.6,'sine',.05),300)}
function gjImpact(foe,big){const a=big?GBL:GP2;qiShards(foe,[a,'#fff',big?GB2:GP1],18);flare(foe,a,big?170:120);petals(foe,[GP1,GP2,'#fff'],big?8:12);slashC(foe,big?1:0,a);slashC(foe,2,'#fff');colFx(foe,a,0);shw(foe,a);ring(foe,'#fff');ring(foe,a);burst(foe,a);burst(foe,'#fff');motesR(foe,[a,'#fff',big?GB2:GP1],big?18:12);shk();snd(110,.3,'sawtooth',.1)}
function gjShroud(me){const [x,y]=pc(me);const e=fxA(`position:fixed;left:${x-100}px;top:${y-150}px;width:200px;height:260px;z-index:47;pointer-events:none;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 8px ${GP2})`,[{opacity:0},{opacity:1,offset:.25},{opacity:1,offset:.7},{opacity:0,transform:'translateY(-20px)'}],{duration:1100},1200);e.innerHTML='<svg viewBox="0 0 200 260" width="200" height="260" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round">'+[['#fff',3,'M30 250C0 190 60 150 40 90S70 20 60 0'],[GP2,4,'M100 255C70 200 140 150 110 100S140 30 120 0'],[GBL,3,'M170 250C140 190 200 150 170 90S190 20 180 0'],[GP1,2.5,'M65 255C35 200 100 150 80 90S100 30 90 0']].map(([c,w,d],i)=>`<path d="${d}" stroke="${c}" stroke-width="${w}" pathLength="1" stroke-dasharray="1" stroke-dashoffset="1"><animate attributeName="stroke-dashoffset" from="1" to="0" dur=".7s" begin="${i*.08}s" fill="freeze"/></path>`).join('')+'</svg>'}
async function gjOrbit(foe){const [x,y]=pc(foe);[[GP2,0],[GBL,180]].forEach(([c,a0])=>{for(let k=0;k<6;k++)fxA(`position:fixed;left:${x-8}px;top:${y-8}px;width:${16-k*2}px;height:${16-k*2}px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(#fff,${c});box-shadow:0 0 14px ${c};z-index:50;pointer-events:none`,[{opacity:0,transform:`rotate(${a0}deg) translateX(20px)`},{opacity:1-k*.14,transform:`rotate(${a0+360}deg) translateX(80px)`,offset:.6},{opacity:0,transform:`rotate(${a0+540}deg) translateX(0px) scale(.4)`}],{duration:700,delay:k*28,easing:'ease-in-out'},900)});snd(500,.5,'sine',.05);await wt(700);flare(foe,'#fff',200);flash(GBL)}
async function gjSwap(me,foe){const idx=foe.hand.map((c,i)=>i).sort((a,b)=>foe.hand[b].a-foe.hand[a].a).slice(0,2);if(!idx.length)return log('상대 패가 없다');await gjOrbit(foe);
 for(const i of idx){const out=foe.hand[i],pool=foe.deck.map((c,k)=>k).filter(k=>foe.deck[k].id!==out.id);if(!pool.length){log('교체할 카드가 없다');continue}const k=rnd(pool),inc=foe.deck[k];foe.deck[k]=out;foe.hand[i]=inc;log(`${who(foe)}의 ${out.n}(${out.a})이 ${inc.n}(으)로 교체됨`);ring(foe,GP2);ring(foe,GBL);burst(foe,'#fff');motesR(foe,[GP1,GBL,'#fff'],12);render();await wt(380)}}
FX.gj=async function(me,foe){const dk=dimOn(foe);dk.style.background='radial-gradient(circle,rgba(40,60,160,.3),rgba(4,6,24,.9))';
 try{cutIn('견우&직녀',GBL,GP2,'#0a1030');bn('牽 牛 織 女');stamp('緣','#fff',GP2,260);log('견우와 직녀의 검기가 별빛을 가른다');aurora(GBL,GP2,1800);starfall(['#fff',GP2,GBL],14,900);vign('rgba(10,16,60,.8)',1500);groundC(me,300,1700,GBL,'#1a2a8a');motes(me,['#fff',GP2,GBL],30);runeRing(me,GP2,GBL);petals(me,[GP1,GP2,'#fff'],14);colFx(me,GP2,-30);colFx(me,GBL,30);snd(70,1,'sine',.12);await wt(1200);
  flare(me,GP2,140);await gjQi(me,foe,'p',-45);gjImpact(foe,false);await hit(foe,1);if(foe.hp<=0)return;
  flare(me,GBL,170);await gjQi(me,foe,'b',45);gjImpact(foe,true);await hit(foe,1);if(foe.hp<=0)return;
  bn('星 換');log('상대의 공격력 높은 카드 2장을 다른 카드로 바꾼다');await gjSwap(me,foe);
  bn('郎 君 劍 氣');log('낭군의 검기!');flare(me,'#fff',190);await gjQi(me,foe,'b',0);gjImpact(foe,true);await hit(foe,1);if(foe.hp<=0)return;
  bn('壽 衣');log('수의를 지어 체력 회복');gjShroud(me);gjAura(me);petals(me,[GP1,GP2,'#fff'],12);await wt(250);await heal(me,3);await wt(700);
  bn('烏 鵲 橋 再 會');log('견우와 직녀가 만난다 — 오작교의 만남 효과는 나만 받는다');starfall(['#fff',GBL],8,500);gjBridge(me);await wt(700);flare(me,'#fff',240);await heal(me,1);await wt(500);
 }finally{dimOff(dk)}};
CB.gj='2회 피해 → 상대 공격력 높은 카드 2장 교체 → 낭군의 검기 1회 → 수의 회복 3 → 오작교 재회(나만 회복 1)';PAL.gj=[GBL,GP2,'#0a1030'];

// ===== 통합 검기 엔진 (일식(달) 검기와 같은 크기 240×132, 곡선 비행 → 접촉 시 자연스럽게 소멸) =====
function qiFly(me,foe,o){return new Promise(res=>{const [x0,y0]=pc(me),[x1,y1]=pc(foe),W=o.W||240,H=o.H||132,dur=o.dur||480,off=o.off||0,gl=o.gl,id=++_ssid,cx=(x0+x1)/2+off,cy=(y0+y1)/2;let n=0;
 const html=()=>{const k=id+'_'+(++n);return `<svg width="${W}" height="${H}" viewBox="0 0 240 132" style="display:block"><defs><linearGradient id="q${k}" x1="0" y1="1" x2="1" y2="0"><stop offset="0" stop-color="${o.cs[0]}"/><stop offset=".55" stop-color="${o.cs[1]}"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="${o.cs[2]}"/></linearGradient></defs><path d="M8 108Q120-46 232 24Q128 30 8 108Z" fill="url(#q${k})" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M26 98Q122-18 222 28" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="1.2" opacity=".8"/></svg>`};
 const mk=z=>mkE('',`position:fixed;left:0;top:0;width:${W}px;height:${H}px;z-index:${z};pointer-events:none;will-change:transform,opacity;opacity:0;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 8px ${gl})`);
 const pos=u=>[(1-u)*(1-u)*x0+2*u*(1-u)*cx+u*u*x1,(1-u)*(1-u)*y0+2*u*(1-u)*cy+u*u*y1],ang=u=>Math.atan2(2*(1-u)*(cy-y0)+2*u*(y1-cy),2*(1-u)*(cx-x0)+2*u*(x1-cx))*180/Math.PI+90,tf=(x,y,u,s)=>`translate(${x-W/2}px,${y-H/2}px) rotate(${ang(u)}deg) scale(${s})`;
 const m=mk(52);m.innerHTML=html();let t0=0,lg=0,ls=0,lf=0;snd(o.f||420,.35,'triangle',.07);snd((o.f||420)*2,.25,'sine',.04);
 const f=now=>{if(!t0)t0=now;const t=Math.min(1,(now-t0)/dur),u=t*t*(1.5-.5*t),[x,y]=pos(u),s=(.35+.65*Math.min(1,t*2.2))*(1+.3*t);m.style.transform=tf(x,y,u,s);m.style.opacity=Math.min(1,t*7);
  if(t<1&&now-lg>46){lg=now;const g=mk(50);g.style.filter='none';g.innerHTML=html();g.style.transform=tf(x,y,u,s*.95);g.animate([{opacity:.5},{opacity:0,transform:tf(x,y,u,s*.5)}],{duration:260,fill:'forwards'});setTimeout(()=>g.remove(),280)}
  if(o.stars&&t<1&&now-ls>70){ls=now;const a=document.createElement('div');a.textContent=['✦','✧'][n%2];a.style.cssText=`position:fixed;left:${x+(Math.random()-.5)*110}px;top:${y+(Math.random()-.5)*70}px;font-size:${8+Math.random()*10}px;color:${n%3?'#fff':o.gl};text-shadow:0 0 8px ${o.gl};z-index:51;pointer-events:none`;document.body.appendChild(a);a.animate([{opacity:1,transform:'scale(.4)'},{opacity:0,transform:`translateY(${10+Math.random()*24}px) scale(1.2) rotate(120deg)`}],{duration:520});setTimeout(()=>a.remove(),540)}
  if((o.fire||o.pet)&&t<1&&now-lf>40){lf=now;const cl=o.fire||o.pet,c=cl[Math.random()*cl.length|0],z=4+Math.random()*7,d=document.createElement('div');d.style.cssText=`position:fixed;left:${x-z/2+(Math.random()-.5)*W*.6}px;top:${y-z/2+(Math.random()-.5)*H*.6}px;width:${z}px;height:${o.fire?z*1.6:z}px;border-radius:${o.fire?'50% 50% 50% 50%/70% 70% 30% 30%':'70% 0 70% 0'};background:${c};box-shadow:0 0 10px ${c};z-index:51;pointer-events:none`;document.body.appendChild(d);d.animate([{opacity:.95,transform:'translateY(0) scale(1)'},{opacity:0,transform:`translate(${(Math.random()-.5)*30}px,${o.fire?-34:24}px) scale(.2) rotate(${o.fire?0:200}deg)`}],{duration:420});setTimeout(()=>d.remove(),440)}
  if(t>=1){m.animate([{opacity:1},{opacity:0,transform:tf(x1,y1,1,1.8)}],{duration:170,fill:'forwards'});setTimeout(()=>m.remove(),190);res();return}requestAnimationFrame(f)};requestAnimationFrame(f)})}
function qiShards(s,cols,n=16){n=n*.65|0;const [x,y]=pc(s);for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const a=Math.random()*6.283,d=40+Math.random()*90,c=cols[i%cols.length],z=4+Math.random()*6;fxA(`position:fixed;left:${x}px;top:${y}px;width:${z}px;height:${z*2.2}px;background:${c};box-shadow:0 0 8px ${c};clip-path:polygon(50% 0,100% 50%,50% 100%,0 50%);z-index:55;pointer-events:none`,[{opacity:1,transform:'translate(0,0) rotate(0) scale(1)'},{opacity:0,transform:`translate(${Math.cos(a)*d}px,${Math.sin(a)*d}px) rotate(${Math.random()*540}deg) scale(.2)`}],{duration:420+Math.random()*280,easing:'ease-out'},800)}}
function hfQi(me,foe,k,n){return qiFly(me,foe,{W:128,H:70,fire:[HG,HT,HS,'#fff'],cs:[HG,HT,HS],gl:HT,off:(k-(n-1)/2)*(n>1?90:0),dur:500,f:300+k*90})}
async function tbQi(me,foe,k,s){await wt(k*180);return qiFly(me,foe,{cs:[TS,TL,TW],gl:TS,off:s*70,dur:520,f:520+k*180})}
function gjQi(me,foe,t,off){const big=t==='b';return qiFly(me,foe,{cs:big?[GB1,GB2,GW]:[GP1,GP2,GW],gl:big?GBL:GP2,W:big?132:84,H:big?73:46,pet:[GP1,GP2,'#fff'],off,dur:480,stars:big,f:big?420:700})}
async function ssQi(me,foe){const [x0,y0]=pc(me);fxA(`position:fixed;left:${x0-90}px;top:${y0-90}px;width:180px;height:180px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,#fff,${RC} 35%,transparent 70%);z-index:47;pointer-events:none`,[{opacity:0,transform:'scale(.2)'},{opacity:1,transform:'scale(1.2)',offset:.6},{opacity:0,transform:'scale(2.2)'}],{duration:700},900);runeRing(me,RC,RD);ssEmbers(me,20,120);snd(180,.6,'sawtooth',.06);await wt(550);
 await qiFly(me,foe,{cs:['#3a0008','#b01020','#ff5a4a'],gl:RC,dur:540,f:300});qiShards(foe,[RC,'#ff8a6a','#fff',RD],22);ssNova(foe,true);slashC(foe,1,RC);slashC(foe,3,'#fff');slam(foe,RC,6);ssCrescent(foe,0,RC,240);ssCrescent(foe,120,'#fff',160,90);await wt(500)}

// ===== 공통 고퀄 이펙트 도구 =====
function flare(s,c,sz,d=0){const [x,y]=pc(s);[0,90,45,135].forEach((r,i)=>fxA(`position:fixed;left:${x-sz/(i>1?3:2)}px;top:${y-(i>1?2:3)}px;width:${i>1?sz*.66:sz}px;height:${i>1?4:6}px;border-radius:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,${c} 30%,#fff 50%,${c} 70%,transparent);box-shadow:0 0 16px ${c};z-index:56;pointer-events:none;rotate:${r}deg`,[{opacity:0,transform:'scaleX(0)'},{opacity:1,transform:'scaleX(1)',offset:.3},{opacity:0,transform:'scaleX(1.2) scaleY(.2)'}],{duration:540,delay:d},800))}
function flames(s,cols,n,sp,h,dy=40){n=Math.ceil(n*.5);const [x,y]=pc(s);for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const c=cols[i%cols.length],w=14+Math.random()*16,id=++_ssid,e=fxA(`position:fixed;left:${x+(Math.random()-.5)*sp-w/2}px;top:${y+dy}px;width:${w}px;height:${w*2.4}px;z-index:44;pointer-events:none;transform-origin:50% 100%;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 8px ${c})`,[{opacity:0,transform:'translateY(0) scale(.3,.2)'},{opacity:.95,transform:`translateY(${-h*.4}px) scale(1,1)`,offset:.3},{opacity:.8,transform:`translateY(${-h*.7}px) scale(.8,1.25) skewX(${(Math.random()-.5)*20}deg)`,offset:.65},{opacity:0,transform:`translateY(${-h}px) scale(.3,1.5)`}],{duration:900+Math.random()*600,delay:Math.random()*700},1800);e.innerHTML=`<svg viewBox="0 0 20 48" width="100%" height="100%"><defs><linearGradient id="fl${id}" x1="0" y1="1" x2="0" y2="0"><stop offset="0" stop-color="${c}"/><stop offset=".65" stop-color="${c}"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#fff"/></linearGradient></defs><path d="M10 0C14 14 22 22 10 46C-2 22 6 14 10 0Z" fill="url(#fl${id})" opacity=".9"/></svg>`}}
function groundC(s,sz,dur,c1,c2){const [x,y]=pc(s);fxA(`position:fixed;left:${x-sz/2}px;top:${y+10}px;width:${sz}px;height:${sz}px;z-index:40;pointer-events:none;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid ${c1};box-shadow:0 0 24px ${c1},inset 0 0 30px ${c2};background:repeating-conic-gradient(${c1}55 0 4deg,transparent 4deg 22deg),radial-gradient(circle,${c2}99,transparent 70%)`,[{opacity:0,transform:'perspective(500px) rotateX(68deg) rotate(0deg) scale(.2)'},{opacity:1,transform:'perspective(500px) rotateX(68deg) rotate(200deg) scale(1)',offset:.15},{opacity:1,transform:`perspective(500px) rotateX(68deg) rotate(${dur/3}deg) scale(1.05)`,offset:.85},{opacity:0,transform:`perspective(500px) rotateX(68deg) rotate(${dur/3+120}deg) scale(1.4)`}],{duration:dur,easing:'ease-in-out'},dur+200)}
function vign(c,dur){fxA(`position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:15;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 55%,transparent 30%,${c})`,[{opacity:0},{opacity:1,offset:.25},{opacity:1,offset:.75},{opacity:0}],{duration:dur},dur+100)}
function aurora(c1,c2,dur){fxA(`position:fixed;inset:-10% 0 30% 0;z-index:14;pointer-events:none;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0 30px,${c1}66 30px 80px,transparent 80px 130px,${c2}55 130px 170px,transparent 170px 230px);-webkit-mask:linear-gradient(transparent,#000 40%,transparent);mask:linear-gradient(transparent,#000 40%,transparent)`,[{opacity:0,transform:'translateX(-40px) scaleY(.6)'},{opacity:.9,transform:'translateX(0) scaleY(1)',offset:.3},{opacity:.8,transform:'translateX(30px) scaleY(1.1)',offset:.75},{opacity:0,transform:'translateX(60px) scaleY(1)'}],{duration:dur},dur+100)}
function starfall(cols,n,dur){n=n*.55|0;for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const x=Math.random()*innerWidth,c=cols[i%cols.length],L=40+Math.random()*60;fxA(`position:fixed;left:${x}px;top:-60px;width:2px;height:${L}px;background:linear-gradient(transparent,${c},#fff);box-shadow:0 0 8px ${c};z-index:49;pointer-events:none;rotate:18deg`,[{opacity:0,transform:'translate(0,0)'},{opacity:1,offset:.2},{opacity:0,transform:`translate(${innerHeight*.35}px,${innerHeight*1.05}px)`}],{duration:650+Math.random()*350,delay:Math.random()*dur},dur+1200)}}
function petals(s,cols,n){n=n*.55|0;const [x,y]=pc(s);for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const c=cols[i%cols.length];fxA(`position:fixed;left:${x+(Math.random()-.5)*200}px;top:${y-120-Math.random()*60}px;width:10px;height:14px;border-radius:70% 0 70% 0;background:${c};box-shadow:0 0 8px ${c};z-index:48;pointer-events:none`,[{opacity:0,transform:'translate(0,0) rotate(0)'},{opacity:1,offset:.2},{opacity:0,transform:`translate(${(Math.random()-.5)*120}px,${150+Math.random()*120}px) rotate(${360+Math.random()*360}deg)`}],{duration:1400+Math.random()*800,delay:Math.random()*600},2600)}}

CB.ss='패에 김시언(대부) → 능력 변경: 대부 사용 + 검기 + 사사태아 · 김시언 → 독 바람 · 사사태아: 공격 1회 무효';
PAL.ss=['#ff3a3a','#7a0010','#14000a'];

const _mo=motes,_mr=motesR,_pa=parts;motes=(s,c,n)=>_mo(s,c,Math.max(4,n*.6|0));motesR=(s,c,n)=>_mr(s,c,Math.max(4,n*.6|0));parts=(s,k,c,n)=>_pa(s,k,c,Math.max(4,n*.6|0));
FX.jiw=async function(me,foe){log('생선을 건져 올린다!');await heal(me,1);await heal(me,1);if(Math.random()<.5){log('발톱으로 할퀸다!');await hit(foe,1);if(foe.hp>0)await hit(foe,1)}else log('할퀴기는 빗나갔다…')};
CB.jiw='생선 회복 2회 → 50% 발톱 2회 피해';
</script></body></html>
